KFYR (Radio station : Bismarck, N.D.)
spatial: United States; North Dakota; Burleigh County (N.D.); Bismarck (N.D.);
description: Cookbook compiled by KFYR radio for it's Ruby Anniversary 1925-1965. The subtitle to the cookbook is "way to a man's Heart" and the recipes were all submitted by listeners of the radio station. Contents: Breads and rolls, Cakes, Candies, Cookies, Desserts, Hot dishes, Meats, Pies, and Salads.
